description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Dr. Mundo''' charges up a defibrillator for up to 3 seconds, dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds to nearby enemies and storing 80% – 95% (based on level) of post-mitigation damage he takes as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]], reduced to 25% after the first 0.75 seconds.
description.text: Active: Dr. Mundo charges up a defibrillator for up to 3 seconds, dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds to nearby enemies and storing 80% – 95% (based on level) of post-mitigation damage he takes as grey health on his health bar, reduced to 25% after the first 0.75 seconds.

description2.raw: ''Heart Zapper'' can be recast after 0.<small>5</small> seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
description2.text: Heart Zapper can be recast after 0.5 seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.

description3.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Dr. Mundo''' detonates the defibrillator, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] for 50% of [[Health#Grey health|grey health]], increased to 100% if at least one enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] or large [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]] is hit.
description3.text: Recast: Dr. Mundo detonates the defibrillator, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and healing for 50% of grey health, increased to 100% if at least one enemy champion or large monster is hit.

notes.raw: * The charge up applies [[File:Poison Trail.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent area damage]] [[:Damage|persistent area damage]] and the detonation deals [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]]. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only block the detonation. * ''Heart Zapper'' will occasionally deal an additional tick of damage.(bug) * ''Heart Zapper'' and its recast will buffer and cast at the end of [[File:Dr. Mundo Infected Bonesaw.png|20xpx|border|link=Dr. Mundo#Infected Bonesaw|An icon for Dr. Mundo's ability Infected Bonesaw]] [[Dr. Mundo#Infected Bonesaw|Infected Bonesaw's]] cast time if attempted to cast during it. ** As with all buffering of this type, another input such as a movement command can override the buffering of the spell again.
notes.text:
The charge up applies persistent area damage and the detonation deals area damage.
Spell shield will only block the detonation.
Heart Zapper will occasionally deal an additional tick of damage.(bug)
Heart Zapper and its recast will buffer and cast at the end of Infected Bonesaw's cast time if attempted to cast during it.
* As with all buffering of this type, another input such as a movement command can override the buffering of the spell again.
